trigger: Amendment or supersession of controlling canon
immediate_effect: Affected artifacts and mappings reviewed or suspended.

trigger: Source hash, byte length, or path mismatch
immediate_effect: Affected source-based claims fail closed until reconciled.

trigger: Previously unavailable historical source becomes available

immediate_effect: Affected gate re-closes unless renewed or closed.
Certification has no authority effect until durable record exists.
Affected readiness or closure claim reviewed.

trigger: Accepted residual risk materializes or severity changes
required_notification: Risk owner and Founder where required

trigger: Overclaim detected in public, PR, release, or governance text
immediate_effect: Statement corrected and affected claim reviewed.

trigger: Release head, environment, feature scope, or provider changes
immediate_effect: Production/pilot readiness claim reviewed for new scope.
required_notification: Release owner and Founder where required

trigger: External legal, contract, regulatory, or court obligation conflicts
immediate_effect: Internal waiver or override suspended for affected obligation.

trigger: Maintenance cadence missed without certified substitute cycle

immediate_effect: Pilot authorization or evidence substitution suspended
required_notification: Founder, privacy owner, and incident owner
